trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing extra to do for it beyond finishing everything else on this list, so treat the roadmap below as your route to it. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from start to finish. Follow the on-screen objectives, drive and fight where the mission asks, and the trophy unlocks when the mission-complete screen appears. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Story progress is linear, so keep taking the next mission marker until the chapter closes and this trophy pops. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Work through the chapter's mission markers in order; the trophy unlocks as soon as the final mission of the chapter ends. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Keep following the story markers until the chapter's last mission is done; nothing here is missable, so just play it through. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The chapter trophy pops the moment its final mission completes, so push the story forward whenever you are between side activities. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission. This is the gold story trophy, so finish Chapters 1 to 4 first and then play the finale to its end credits; it unlocks with the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Take the mission marker when it appears, follow its objectives to the end, and the trophy pops on completion. If you finish the story, mission replay lets you redo any mission you missed. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so finish any setup objectives, then run the heist itself to the end; the trophy unlocks on the mission-complete screen. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission marker and its objectives through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission from its marker to the end and the trophy unlocks on completion; mission replay covers it if you ever need a second run. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Work through the mission's objectives at the airport area and finish it; the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Follow the mission through its objectives to the end; the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen. That means the full story, all stranger strands, the counted collectibles and activities on this list, and the exploration goals; check the in-game completion percentage after each session and mop up whichever category is still short. It is a long grind, so save it for after the story and chase it category by category. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total: jumps, near misses, airtime and other stunt moments the game counts. They add up naturally while you drive fast and jump ramps, but the quickest farm is to repeat a big jump or ramp run in free roam and let the counter climb. The trophy is silver and the count is 250, so expect a dedicated session. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: the activities the game lists, such as racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world pastimes. You only need one try of each, not a win, so visit each activity spot once and sample it. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range, work through every challenge, and beat each one's gold score or time. Use the weapon the challenge gives you, take the steady shots first, and replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it turns gold. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; fly the drone through the gates, learn the course line on a practice run, then race for the win. Tick the locations off one by one on the map until all 14 are won. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Enter races from their map markers, pick a fast vehicle you handle well, and work through the list until 20 different races are won. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear when you fish with Cal; cast where the fish are, watch the line tension, and reel steadily without snapping it. Because this is tied to a specific character encounter, do it the first time the challenge is offered rather than leaving it for later. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Find an arcade machine in the open world, pick any game, and play it through to its end screen; you do not need a high score, just a full completion. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by playing his missions in order until his final one is complete. Stranger-style strands unlock as you explore and progress the story, so keep checking for Andy's marker and work through his chain to its last mission. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by playing his missions in order until his final one is complete. His markers appear as you explore Leonida and advance the story; follow the chain to its last mission and the trophy pops. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by playing his missions in order until his final one is complete. Keep an eye out for Billy's marker while exploring, run his chain to the end, and the trophy unlocks with his last mission. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger; finishing all of a stranger's missions counts one strand. Explore the map for stranger markers, finish eight complete chains, and this silver trophy pops. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by playing his missions in order until his final one is complete. His chain opens up as you explore and progress; run it through to the last mission for the trophy. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by playing his missions in order until his final one is complete. Follow his markers when they appear, complete the chain, and the trophy unlocks with his final mission. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Each spot is a marked location where you sit and meditate; visit every one and complete the meditation there. Work through the map region by region so none is skipped. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting mission, follow the trail and clues to the animal's location, then take it down cleanly with a suitable weapon. The animal is a one-off target, so track it carefully rather than scaring it off. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida and in shops; each set needs every card in it, so collect widely, check your collection screen for gaps, and trade or buy the ones you are missing until three sets are complete. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo spot feature: find a marked spot, frame the shot and take it. Each location counts once, so keep visiting new spots around the map until the counter hits 100. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities, and they stack up across normal play; check the challenges menu to see which ones are close to done, then finish the easiest 50 first. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Get the heat up with your partner in the car, break line of sight, hide until the stars fade, and stay out of sight until you are clear. Do it during a partner moment, since you need your partner with you when the stars drop. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three close shops, hit each one quickly, keep your partner with you, and do not let the wanted level clear between robberies. If the stars drop, the chain breaks and you start over. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive for the first time counts, so hop into anything you have not driven yet: cars, bikes, trucks, boats and planes all add to the list. Cruise busy streets and parking lots to find fresh models fast. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with at least five enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout gives you the targets you need. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA airport: get into a plane at the airport and take off without following the normal departure routine. Steal a plane on the tarmac and lift off; the trophy pops once you are airborne on your own terms. Expect wanted attention, so be quick. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and survive the heat that comes with it. Steal a Rhino when the military responds at high wanted levels, or find one at a base, then drive it and deal with the response it draws. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, back out and try again rather than fighting through it. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each vault job, crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear of the cops before the next. Five successful vault robberies with clean escapes earn this silver trophy. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. A quiet road and a fast getaway car make the escape much easier. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail through every named area on the map until each one registers as visited. Work through the map systematically, region by region, and check the exploration progress to find the areas you have not set foot in yet. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it and get out. Each gang's territory holds its own operations, so work through the map gang by gang until all 9 are robbed. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. It is a small moment trophy, so do it when you are next on the beachfront rather than leaving it to the end. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's glass front and out onto the street, the way the classic scene plays. Pick a showroom, build speed inside or outside, and crash straight through the window. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end of the game. Visit the alley, start a game, and bowl all your frames; the trophy pops when the game finishes. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This trophy is tied to a partnership moment in the story: keep playing the main story and the duo's shared success will trigger it. It pops from story progress, so push the missions forward and it will come. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices in the story; the game tracks how many meaningful choices you have made, with the community count pointing to 500. Pick the decisive option whenever the game offers one instead of staying neutral, and keep choosing through the story until the trophy pops. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail an attempt at something, then succeed at the very next try. It is a luck-and-persistence trophy tied to a specific second attempt, so when a try fails, retry it right away instead of wandering off; the success on the retry is what counts. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida. Strange happenings hide in out-of-the-way places at odd hours, so explore remote spots, visit at night, and investigate anything odd you spot. This is a one-off event trophy, so take the time to look around when something feels off. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon while driving past. Line up a pedestrian from a slow-moving car, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops when the hit lands. A quiet street and a slow roll make the timing easy. Source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide.
trophies.source: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who cleans money and keep feeding them through until the total hits $250,000. It adds up across the whole playthrough, so launder regularly instead of hoarding bills. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Buy weapons, clothes, cars, food and gear from any shop; every dollar counts toward the same $100,000 total. It builds up naturally over a full playthrough, and big purchases like vehicles close the gap fast. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings around Leonida; save up, visit each listing and buy every one. The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours, so keep an eye on your cash and buy them as you can afford them. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are registered. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most first. Source: Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5).
trophies.source: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (PS5)
